reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Sun Cream Light 50mL
reviews.text: This was an okay mineral sunscreen, I only use it in my eye area because I get watery stinging eyes with chemical sunscreen. It does have a white cast like all other mineral sunscreen. Im not too sure if it’s because of my eye cream or face serum but this product does pill just a bit
reviews.zh: 呢款礦物防曬一般，我淨係用喺眼周位置，因為用化學防曬會令到我雙眼流眼水兼有刺痛感。佢同其他礦物防曬一樣會泛白。我唔太肯定係因為我支眼霜定係面部精華，但呢款產品確實會輕微搓泥。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Sun Cream Light 50mL
reviews.text: This sunscreen is really lightweight and comfortable on the skin. It absorbs quickly, doesn’t leave a white cast, and works great under makeup. I also love that it doesn’t clog my pores or feel greasy. It honestly feels more like a moisturizer, which makes it easy to use every day.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬真係好輕透，貼面又舒服。吸收得好快，唔會泛白，搽完化妝都好啱用。我亦都好鍾意佢唔會塞毛孔又唔會油笠笠。講真感覺似多過保濕霜，所以日日用都好方便。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Sun Cream Light 50mL
reviews.text: I’ve been liking this sunscreen and how it feels on the skin. The texture is good, doesn’t leave a heavy feeling on the skin or leave me super greasy or oily. I do need to reapply often (hourly ish) to avoid sunburn as I live in Australia and the sun is harsh here and the weather hot. I found it leaves a slight white cast but once it absorbs you can’t really tell.
reviews.zh: 我一直幾鍾意呢款防曬同佢貼面嘅感覺。質地好，唔會令皮膚有厚重感，亦唔會令我好油笠或者油膩。我住喺澳洲，呢度太陽猛天氣又熱，所以我要成日補塗（大約每個鐘一次）以防曬傷。我發現佢會有少少泛白，不過一吸收咗就睇唔出嚟。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Sun Cream Light 50mL
reviews.text: This sunscreen is great. I have sensitive, combo, acne prone skin and it works great for my skin. I use the blue one as well when my skin is dry around my mouth. But these sunscreens dont make me break out ! Been using for a couple of years now and i love it and recommend it to everyone ik. Especially the blue hyalu cica one!
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬好正。我係敏感肌、混合性、容易爆瘡嘅膚質，用喺我塊面好啱。我嘴邊皮膚乾燥嗰陣都會用佢哋另一款藍色嘅。不過呢啲防曬都唔會令我爆瘡！已經用咗幾年，我好鍾意佢，仲推薦畀所有我識嘅人。尤其係藍色嗰款 hyalu-cica！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Sun Cream Light 50mL
reviews.text: I’ve been using chemical sunscreen for the last couple years and wanted to experiment with mineral sunscreen again. Texture is a little thicker compared to chemical, but will still rub in. With mineral there is always a small white/grey cast, but this one is a better one on the market. I will say it didn’t agree with both my serum & moisturizer & pilled so bad so I tried using the leftover ampoule from the sheet mask from the same brand as my serum & it didn’t pill. So fair warning you might need to use their products underneath. Overall I notice a huge difference in my skin & I think I’m converted to mineral!
reviews.zh: 過去幾年我一直用化學防曬，想再試吓礦物防曬。質地同化學嗰啲比係厚少少，但都仲搽得開。礦物防曬一定會有少少白/灰泛白，不過呢款已經係市面比較好嘅一款。我要講，佢同我支精華同保濕霜都夾唔到，搓泥搓到好誇張，所以我就改用咗同我精華同一個品牌嘅面膜入面剩低嘅安瓶，咁就唔搓泥。所以提早講聲，你可能需要用返佢哋自己嘅產品打底。整體嚟講，我見到皮膚有明顯改善，覺得自己已經轉會去礦物防曬！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Sun Cream Light 50mL
reviews.text:
¡Es uno de mis protectores solares favoritos! No soy fanática de los bloqueadores que te dejan la piel "glowy" y este lo deja con un efecto más matificante (lo esperaba más matificante pero no me molesta ¡Le da un aspecto saludable sin que se vea grasoso!).

No te deja una capa blanca, es ligero y el precio que lo manejas en Olive Young hace que valga mucho mas la pena ya que me compre dos :p. ¡Suerte con la compra de sus productos desde México!
reviews.zh: 係我最鍾意嘅防曬之一！我唔係好鍾意嗰啲用完會令皮膚「水光」嘅防曬，而呢款嘅效果比較霧面（我本來預期更加霧面但都唔介意，因為佢可以令皮膚睇落健康又唔會油笠笠！）。唔會留白色薄膜，質地輕盈，而且 Olive Young 嘅價錢令佢更加抵用，所以我買咗兩支 :p。祝大家由墨西哥買得開心！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Sun Cream Light 50mL
reviews.text: I love everything skin1004 offers, so I was surprised to learn I don't like this sunscreen. It does the job like it's not the worst sunscreen I've ever tried, but it definitely isn't my favorite. I heard it was good for acne-prone skin, so I wanted to try it after using the hyalu-cica one. The texture is really thick and sometimes difficult to blend. It leaves a pretty noticeable whitecast on my skin. It also pills up under my makeup, so I can only use this on no makeup days /: overall I wish I would’ve stuck with the hyalu-cica version.
reviews.zh: skin1004 出嘅嘢我都鍾意，所以知道原來自己唔鍾意呢款防曬嗰陣真係好意外。佢做到基本功能，又唔係我用過最差嘅防曬，但肯定唔係我最鍾意。我聽講佢對容易爆瘡嘅皮膚好，所以用完 hyalu-cica 想試吓呢款。質地真係好厚，有時好難推開。喺我塊面會留低好明顯嘅泛白。化妝底下都會搓泥，所以淨係喺唔化妝嘅日子先用得到 /: 整體嚟講，希望我當初繼續用返 hyalu-cica 嗰款就好喇。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Sun Cream Light 50mL
reviews.text: Es un protector físico, lo que significa que no te irrita los ojos y es de los blancos, pero este es el mejor porque se absorbe y ya se quita lo blanco, no es grasoso pero si quieres retocarlo entonces si se te hace la capa blanca, así que solo lo recomiendo para usarlo en la mañana y no hacer los retoques con este mismo porque vas a parecer un fantasma en l segunda capa
reviews.zh: 呢個係物理防曬，即係唔會刺激眼睛，屬於會泛白嘅防曬入面嘅一種，但呢隻係最好嘅，因為佢會被吸收同埋泛白會消退，唔油笠。但如果你想補妝嘅話，咁就真係會形成白色一層，所以我只推薦喺早上用，唔好用同一枝嚟補妝，因為第二層你會睇落似個幽靈。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
